LABEL: GENUINE DISAGREEMENT between three PMUS routes at one instant, inside a bounded and verified-stable window. Captured read-only.

why_this_is_determinate_and_not_a_measur.note: the stability gates DID reject two samples; the reported one passed all of them, so the 12-tick gap is not latency or an intervening update.

the_finding.reading: This is NOT a parser defect on either side. Each route's own payload is self-consistent and best-first. The three PMUS routes are not serving one coherent book state at one instant.
the_finding.what_it_blocks: E1 prices its first leg off the WS ladder. If the venue's own /book differs by 12 ticks and /bbo by 3 ticks at the same instant, 'the executable price' is not a settled quantity on this venue yet. That is a prerequisite to arming, and a larger one than the original parse question.

what_was_NOT_computed: the YES/NO serialization proof. With no agreed A/B there is nothing to serialize against, so A_bid, B_ask, e1_yes, e1_no and e1_complement are all null rather than guessed.
NOT_A_REGRESSION_FIXTURE: Evidence, not a pinned expectation. Pinning a disagreement would encode an unresolved venue question as correct behaviour.
